pages.title: Chen Huang
pages.text: He who rides it shall live two thousand years. The Chen Huang of the ancient texts resembles a four-horned deer clad in starlit scales, the swiftest of all divine beasts. Lost travelers borne by a Chen Huang could cross an entire wilderness in a single day.

pages.title: Traits
pages.text: In the form of Chen Huang, you gain $(thing)speed and endurance$(0) far beyond mortal limits — the very reason it was revered as an auspicious beast. Distances mortals chase for a lifetime are but a morning stroll to the Chen Huang.

pages.title: Transformation Recipe
pages.text: Arrange these four offerings on the $(item)Spirit Table$(0), then right-click it holding a $(item)Murmol Soul$(0): $(li)golden apple$(li)mango$(li)sugar$(li)honey bottle$(br)Each transformation consumes $(thing)5 XP levels$(0). $(br)Alternatively, craft the $(item)Chen Huang Soul$(0) at a crafting table from an $(item)Ancient Knowledge Scrap (Chen Huang)$(0), a $(item)Murmol Soul$(0) and the four materials above.
